sites.name: Egg Orchard - FPV run (drop to the exit portal)
sites.notes: Hidden avatar parks at the bottom (cell 0x002B0119, 42.4 m from the nearest Surface portal, 6.6 m off the racing line); prime walks it through research-2's 7 PVS anchors top->bottom so ACE sends the creatures on the route (they see 82 of the 82 creatures within 15 m of the line; the stand cell sees 33 of the 33 after segment J). ACE drops objects ~25 s after they leave the avatar PVS: if the upper levels come up empty in a take, shoot the run in legs or hop during the take.

JEV candidate if the film's hero budget allows. [v2 window 4.88–14.33 s of the unchanged 14.33 s take: Film-opening rise up the hall's south wall: climb runs t3-10 (v 1.5-2.5), roofline cleared and LOS to the lower town/River Prosper clear from t11, settling on the reveal at t13-14.3; hero shot so ~0.68x keeps the wall climb plus the full reveal and hold.]
